description.en: SenseNova Token Plan OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Responses-compatible API, with U1 Fast image-generation size adaptation, reasoning normalized onto the standard reasoning_content on both the streaming and non-streaming paths, and exact seven-model Token Plan catalog filtering including deepseek-flash. The Responses arm is stateless: no previous_response_id, no response storage, streaming ends with response.completed and carries no [DONE]; note that store/background now reach upstream, so an explicit true is rejected with 400 instead of being silently dropped by the gateway bridge.
description.zh: 商汤日日新 Token Plan 的 OpenAI、Anthropic 与 Responses 兼容 API：支持 U1 Fast 图像生成尺寸适配、流式与非流式两条路径上统一归一到标准 reasoning_content 字段，以及包含 deepseek-flash 的精确七模型 Token Plan 目录过滤。Responses 臂为无状态：不支持 previous_response_id 与响应存储，流式以 response.completed 结束且不携带 [DONE]；注意 store/background 现已直达上游，显式传 true 会收到 400，而不再被网关桥接静默丢弃。

description.en: Add an inference API key and optionally a console access token for Token Plan quota refresh.
description.zh: 填写推理 API Key，并可选填写控制台访问令牌以刷新 Token Plan 额度。

help_text.en: Optional. Paste the console Bearer JWT to refresh Token Plan pool quota. It is short-lived and must be replaced after expiry.
help_text.zh: 可选。粘贴控制台 Bearer JWT 以刷新 Token Plan 积分池额度；令牌会过期，过期后需重新填写。

help_text.en: Optional legacy fallback only. Normally leave this blank: the plugin reads tenant_id from the console token. This is not the gr_user_id cookie value.
help_text.zh: 仅用于旧版配额接口回退，通常留空。插件会从控制台令牌读取 tenant_id；不要填写 Cookie 中的 gr_user_id。

label.zh: Token Plan 租户 ID（自动获取）

help_text.en: Optional comma-separated override used only by the legacy per-model quota fallback. This does not control the list of models available for inference.
help_text.zh: 可选，逗号分隔的旧版按模型配额回退探测 ID 覆盖列表；此项不决定可调用的模型列表。

label.en: Token Plan quota probe model IDs
label.zh: Token Plan 配额探测模型 ID

title.zh: 连接商汤日日新 Token Plan
